data.name: GalleryHeroLead
data.value: We run a YouTube channel and collect both our own recordings and those you share with us. Here you’ll find audiovisual memories of our shows along with links to the photo galleries of the photographers we trust.

data.name: GalleryVideosIntro
data.value: Visit our YouTube channel to explore recordings of our performances, clips we produce and the ones you send us.

data.name: GalleryFeaturedVideoIntro
data.value: Enjoy this particularly beautiful video created by Elena Cid “Disentropic”.

data.name: GalleryFestivalParagraph
data.value: We also remember the “Pa Cutio Punchacuto” Festival held in 2015 as a tribute to Carlos Casamián, filled with emotion and camaraderie.

data.name: GalleryPhotosIntro
data.value: Our photo archive is extensive, though it isn’t always easy to capture the fast-paced movement, changing lights and contrasts of fire and pyrotechnics.
